title: BAE Falcon Works joint ventures with Lockheed Skunk Works

tellings.quote: BAE has Falcon Works that is BAE's version of skunk works and BAE has joint ventures with Lockheed with skunk works on material sciences on engineering on engines on all of it.

plain: BAE, the defence company, has a unit called Falcon Works that is "BAE's version of Skunk Works," Lockheed's secretive advanced-aircraft division, according to a whistleblower named Dylan Borland. He tells Michels that the two companies run joint ventures through Skunk Works on "material sciences," engineering, engines, "all of it." If so, the most secret aerospace work would cross company lines and national borders.
